checks: Transitivity and addition of the common measure eta give convex order from nu to eta plus twice the repaired midpoint law, with equal mass from the two assumed orders. The intermediate target is supported in the union of the fixed eta support and the compact midpoint image. Both the zero-mass and positive-mass cases satisfy the physical coupling lemma.

The two marginal equalities and coordinate moment equations, expressed with absolute values, are continuous constraints on a fixed weakly compact bounded-measure space. Their data are Borel in the parameter. Countably many dense continuous source tests determine each finite signed coordinate measure, giving the moment equations for all bounded Borel source tests. The selector and kernel evaluation argument give one Borel kernel with these properties on one Borel full-measure set.

The intermediate joint target law beta is exactly the sum of the joint eta and 2rho laws. Their Borel Radon–Nikodym densities are nonnegative and sum to one beta-almost everywhere, so versions may be made valid probabilities everywhere. The tuple joint law has (parameter, midpoint) marginal exactly the joint rho law. Its regular conditional tuple kernel is concentrated on the correct midpoint fiber almost everywhere for that law. Multiplying by the second density ensures that only this full-rho-measure set contributes to the second branch.

For any Borel parameter and output event, the zero branch has integrated measure exactly the eta law by the first density. The second branch has intermediate measure exactly twice the joint rho law. Disintegration followed by either endpoint projection and a factor one half gives exactly the corresponding prescribed endpoint law. Countable determining tests with arbitrary Borel parameter restrictions identify all conditional marginals simultaneously almost everywhere.

All compositions retain the same parameter and source coordinate. Given the intermediate state, each branch's physical conditional mean is the intermediate z, using the full coordinate midpoint identity in the split. The first martingale identity holds also with arbitrary Borel parameter and source tests by integrating its conditional identities. The tower property therefore gives the final physical mean x under the integrated source law.

Coincident physical points can carry multiple tags and all three marked marginals remain exact. After forgetting tags the physical target measure is the sum of eta and the two endpoint marginals, counting shared physical capacity additively. The exact old-law assumption is the displayed convex order for nu and eta plus twice rho_old. No capacity for the physical target sum is among the conclusions.

If the integrated tuple law is zero, the second share vanishes almost everywhere and its conditional version is irrelevant. If the total integrated source law is zero, the conditional mean assertion is vacuous. Versions on joint null sets do not affect any of the marginal identities.
